# Test fixtures

## `attestation/`

Android key attestation certificate chains and their expected values, copied
from Google's [android/keyattestation](https://github.com/android/keyattestation)
repository, directory `testdata/`, at commit
`a508aefbafb5d614e7e814eb0ff2386a702d7812` (September 2026). Relative paths
are preserved (`<device>/sdk<N>/<case>.pem` + `.json`, `invalid/`,
`p256_sha384_intermediate.pem`).

Copyright 2024 Google LLC. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; see
[`attestation/LICENSE`](attestation/LICENSE). The files are unmodified.

`attestation/software_roots.pem` holds the two Android software attestation
root certificates, taken from the same repository
(`src/main/kotlin/SoftwareRoot.kt`, same license).

The subset kept here: `akita/sdk34` (TEE EC, StrongBox RSA, user-auth RSA),
`blueline/sdk28`, `walleye/sdk27` (old attestation versions, factory
provisioned), `caiman/sdk36` (remote key provisioning), `frankel/sdk37` and
`tegu/sdk36` (the 2025 ECDSA P-384 root), `tokay/sdk37/TEE_MLDSA_RKP` (an
ML-DSA key the verifier must reject cleanly), and `invalid/`.

## `vectors/`

Generated by the scripts in `tool/` with throwaway keys (the private keys are
test data only):

- `openssl_vectors.json` — `tool/gen_vectors.py` (OpenSSL 3.6).
- `apple_vectors.json` — `tool/gen_apple_vectors.swift` (macOS Security
  framework, `eciesEncryptionStandardX963SHA256AESGCM` and
  `rsaEncryptionOAEPSHA256`).
- `android_vectors.json` — `tool/AndroidVectors.java` (JCA, mirroring the
  plugin's `CryptoOperations.kt` and OAEP parameters).
